5. With 6 spruce planks, we can now craft 3 spruce signs using 6 spruce planks and 1 stick.

1. Craft 4 spruce planks using 1 spruce log.
2. Gather 2 more spruce logs.
3. Craft 4 spruce planks using 1 spruce log.
4. Craft 6 spruce planks using 1 spruce log.
5. Craft 3 spruce signs using 6 spruce planks and 1 stick.

This sequence ensures we gather all necessary materials before crafting the spruce sign.
